name: fly-dumbbell-decline
title: Fly: Dumbbell (Decline)
primer: This is an exercise for chest and shoulder strengthening.
steps: Lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your body and your feet firmly on the ground.
Hold the dumbbells together above your shoulders with your arms straight out above you. This is your starting position.
Keeping your arms straight and with a slight bend in your elbows lower the dumbbells down towards the floor in an arc, until they are level with your shoulders.
Return to the starting position in a slow controlled manner.
